skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Drive the built-in browser tool (Mixdog Browser Use) on a live web page.
skills.whenToUse: Mixdog browser: interactive pages, forms, sign-in, web-app tests; not URL text or user-viewed tabs.

skills.name: code-tidy
skills.description: Format, lint, apply structural rules, and clean up user-selected code with the tidy tool.
skills.whenToUse: Tidy, format, lint, deslop, or clean up code; not new features or bug fixes.

skills.name: computer-use
skills.description: Drive the built-in computer tool on the local Windows, macOS, or Linux desktop.
skills.whenToUse: Operate or check desktop apps, OS dialogs, user-viewed browser tabs; not tool-covered work.

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create, edit, review, or redline a Word document (.docx/.dotx/.docm) with the office tool.
skills.whenToUse: Create, edit, or review Word files (.docx/.dotx/.docm), including tracked changes; not PDF/slides.

skills.name: history-recall
skills.description: Retrieve and interpret prior sessions, decisions, and unfinished work.
skills.whenToUse: Prior sessions, decisions, or work to resume; not current repo state or standing user preferences.

skills.name: image
skills.description: Make or edit an image through the media tool (Mixdog Media Studio).
skills.whenToUse: Generate or edit still images and assets; not video clips.

skills.name: local-provider
skills.description: Find, install, inspect, repair, or remove Mixdog-managed local GGUF models.
skills.whenToUse: Local/offline GGUF or Hugging Face models, GPU fit, or stalled downloads; not hosted providers.

skills.name: memory-management
skills.description: Inspect and curate approved standing user preferences and constraints.
skills.whenToUse: Standing user preferences and constraints; not past sessions, repo state, settings, or task notes.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Create, read, search, mark up, fill, merge, secure, or OCR a PDF with the office tool.
skills.whenToUse: PDF creation, reading, editing, OCR, forms, security, and table extraction; not Word/slides.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Create, redesign, or review a PowerPoint deck (.pptx) with the office tool.
skills.whenToUse: Create, edit, or review PowerPoint decks, slides, or templates; not Word/PDF/spreadsheets.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Inspect or change persisted Mixdog settings through the built-in setup tool.
skills.whenToUse: Settings, not code/local installs: routes, workflows, MCP, plugins, skill toggles, style, profile.

skills.name: setup-guide
skills.description: Guide a new user through first setup and explain Mixdog concepts.
skills.whenToUse: Mixy's first chat; how to start, what to do first, what a Mixdog term means; not one named setting.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, audit, repair, or simplify your Mixdog skills and their SKILL.md.
skills.whenToUse: Create, audit, repair, or edit skills, including activation failures; not ordinary feature work.

skills.name: test-suite
skills.description: Write, run, diagnose, prune and audit a project's tests without overloading the machine.
skills.whenToUse: Write, fix, run, diagnose, prune or audit tests, flaky failures, suite health; not live UI checks.

skills.name: video
skills.description: Make a short video clip through the media tool (Mixdog Media Studio).
skills.whenToUse: Generate or extend video, or animate stills; not still-image generation or editing.

skills.name: visualize
skills.description: Show mockups, design options, diagrams, and finished artifacts in the side panel beside the chat.
skills.whenToUse: Mockups, previews, design options, diagrams, or showing any finished artifact; not code alone.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Create, edit, audit, or model a spreadsheet (.xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv) with the office tool.
skills.whenToUse: Create, edit, audit, or model Excel/CSV/TSV spreadsheets, formulas, or tables; not Word or PDF.

skills.description: Use when recording the control folder.
